description: Gold correction after the first run (recorded in docs/simulation/ai-evaluation.md): "Someone needs to confirm the consultation venue" is an ownerless action and is now gold, consistent with the other sets. Phase 7 simulation set: one meeting per industry, each built around a named difficulty (clear decisions with several commitments, ambiguous decisions, conflicting dates, unresolved questions, missing owners, duplicate actions, irrelevant conversation, prompt injection, passive voice, hedged statements). Written 2026-10-25 before any run; never tuned against. All names and organisations are fictional.
